The discussion focused on technical limitations regarding messaging platform integrations. It was confirmed that sending references or links via email or phone number is not possible using the relevant API; only an internal ID can be used.
Separately, one participant mentioned having deactivated (or 'paid off') a tool called Superset because it had not been utilized.
decisions: The method for sending references/links via email or phone number is technically impossible using the current API.
